title: Copilot Studio: SharePoint lists as an agent knowledge source
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licensing distinctions and governance controls are supported. One minor correction should acknowledge Microsoft's conflicting descriptions of content freshness for the SharePoint upload route.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes native SharePoint list knowledge for Copilot Studio agents without manual data movement or complex integrations.
claims.quote: With native support, customers can ground AI responses in up-to-date, business-critical data—such as tasks, inventory, customers, or operations—without manual data movement or complex integrations.

claims.claim: Learn already documents SharePoint list knowledge for standard-harness agents.
claims.quote: This article describes features used in agents or agent flows powered by the standard harness. ... Your agent can use these lists as a knowledge source.

claims.claim: A maker opens the agent, selects Add knowledge and SharePoint under Upload file, then browses for a list or enters its URL.
claims.quote: Open the agent. ... Select Add knowledge ... In the Upload file section, select SharePoint. ... Select Browse items to find your desired list, or enter the URL of a specific SharePoint list.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: risk; Open questions
claims.claim: The selected SharePoint lists are ingested into Dataverse.
claims.quote: The selected SharePoint lists are ingested into Dataverse and indexed to improve search results.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The selected lists are indexed.
claims.quote: The selected SharePoint lists are ingested into Dataverse and indexed to improve search results.

claims.claim: Learn says the list connection is real-time.
claims.quote: When you add a SharePoint list as a knowledge source, you create a real-time connection to the source, so the most current data is used for queries and reasoning.
claims.fix: After this sentence add: 'However, the Unstructured data as a knowledge source FAQ describes the file-upload route, which also supports lists, as synchronizing content every four to six hours; Microsoft's descriptions of freshness differ.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/knowledge-unstructured-data#faq, whose Runtime differences table says 'Content is synchronized every four to six hours, based on ingestion completion' for Option 1 and marks SharePoint lists supported.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: Users authenticate with their SharePoint credentials.
claims.quote: Users authenticate by using their SharePoint credentials, which ensures they have permission to access the data before your agent provides a response.

claims.claim: Learn also documents SharePoint list knowledge for Microsoft Copilot harness agents.
claims.quote: Add SharePoint lists (Microsoft Copilot) ... After you connect SharePoint lists to your Copilot Studio agent, it can answer questions grounded in structured SharePoint data.

claims.claim: Microsoft Copilot harness list knowledge supports analytical and aggregation queries.
claims.quote: Analytical and aggregation queries over structured list data

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support

claims.quote: This preview supports large-scale lists. The supported scale is:

claims.claim: The Microsoft Copilot harness page gives up to 10 lists per agent.
claims.quote: Lists per agent | Up to 10 lists.

claims.claim: The Microsoft Copilot harness page gives a supported list size of up to 120,000 rows.
claims.quote: Maximum supported list size | Up to 120,000 rows.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: Quality and latency can degrade beyond 120,000 rows.
claims.quote: You can connect larger lists, but quality and latency might degrade after 120,000 rows.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: The standard-harness quotas page says up to 15 total lists.
claims.quote: SharePoint lists support up to 15 total lists

claims.claim: The quotas page says up to 35,000 rows across all 15 lists.
claims.quote: SharePoint lists support up to 15 total lists, and up to 35,000 rows across all 15 lists, as long as the total rows don't exceed 120,000 rows.

claims.claim: The quotas page also says total rows must not exceed 120,000.
claims.quote: as long as the total rows don't exceed 120,000 rows. For example, you could have 3 lists of 35,000 rows each, or 12 lists with 10,000 rows each.

claims.claim: The quotas page says SharePoint list queries return only the first 2,048 rows.
claims.quote: SharePoint list queries only return data from the first 2,048 rows of data.

claims.claim: The standard-harness SharePoint page recommends up to 10 lists per agent, differing from the quotas page.
claims.quote: For the best results, only use up to 10 lists per agent.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment; Scope
claims.claim: Users need at least Read permission on the SharePoint site or list.
claims.quote: At a minimum, the user must have Read permissions to the SharePoint site or list to access the content.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Learn says the agent responds with no response when the user lacks permission.
claims.quote: If the user doesn't have permission to access the content, the agent responds with "no response."

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The agent surfaces only content the user has permission to access.
claims.quote: By using this option, the agent surfaces only content that the user has permission to access.

claims.quote: Generative answers from SharePoint sources aren't available to guest users in SSO-enabled apps.

claims.claim: Learn says Restricted SharePoint Search blocks use of SharePoint.

claims.claim: No new autonomy or list-writing action is documented for this knowledge-source feature.
claims.quote: Searched: "SharePoint lists" "knowledge" "actions" "Copilot Studio". Opened Add SharePoint as a knowledge source and Add SharePoint lists (Microsoft Copilot); they describe retrieval, analytical reasoning and answers, not list-writing actions.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Scope; Governance guidance

claims.quote: Document libraries aren't supported as lists.

claims.claim: Responses do not use attachment contents.

claims.where: Why it matters; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Microsoft Copilot harness agents are billed for all usage.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot harness agents | No | Billed for all usage. Creation and runtime activities consume Copilot Credits regardless of the user's license.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Microsoft Copilot harness billing starts during building and testing, before an agent is shared.
claims.quote: the Microsoft Copilot harness charges credits from the moment you start building. Experiences such as creating an automated solution with natural language, previewing and testing an agent, and generating and creating agent evaluations all consume credits.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Microsoft Copilot harness usage is not included with a user's Microsoft 365 Copilot licence.
claims.quote: This usage isn't included with a user's Microsoft 365 Copilot license.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Standard-harness employee-facing usage is included in Microsoft Copilot USL when the user is licensed and the agent uses that authenticated user's identity.
claims.quote: are included in the Microsoft Copilot USL when the user of the agent is licensed with Microsoft Copilot, and the agent operates using the authenticated Microsoft Copilot USL user's identity.

claims.claim: The standard-harness included usage is subject to fair usage limits.
claims.quote: Usage is limited to fair usage limits.

claims.claim: The licensing model is mixed, with licensed inclusion for qualifying standard-harness usage and consumption billing for Microsoft Copilot harness usage.
claims.quote: Standard harness agents | Yes, in Microsoft 365 channels ... Microsoft Copilot harness agents | No | Billed for all usage.

claims.where: summary; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Copilot Credits are the usage meter.
claims.quote: Copilot Credits are the unit that measures agent usage.

claims.claim: Microsoft Copilot harness billing includes model tokens.
claims.quote: Copilot Credits are charged for large language model (LLM) tokens, tools (including knowledge and MCPs), and the harness itself.

claims.claim: Microsoft Copilot harness billing includes tools, including knowledge.
claims.quote: Copilot Credits are charged for large language model (LLM) tokens, tools (including knowledge and MCPs), and the harness itself.

claims.quote: Copilot Credits are charged for large language model (LLM) tokens, tools (including knowledge and MCPs), and the harness itself.

claims.claim: The standard-harness rate table lists 2 Copilot Credits for a generative answer.
claims.quote: Generative answer | 2 Copilot Credits | No charge

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: A separate credit rate specific to SharePoint list knowledge is not published.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio SharePoint list knowledge Copilot Credits billing rate. Opened Billing rates and management, Overview of usage-based billing and both SharePoint list knowledge pages; general answer/tool billing is documented, but no list-specific rate.

claims.claim: An environment allocation is not a spending boundary if tenant capacity or pay-as-you-go can supply additional credits.
claims.quote: An allocation isn't a boundary if the environment can continue drawing from tenant capacity or pay-as-you-go billing.

claims.claim: Azure budgets send alerts but do not stop Copilot Studio usage.
claims.quote: Azure budgets and alerts send notifications but don't stop Copilot Studio consumption.

claims.claim: Capacity management requires Power Platform Administrator, Global Administrator or an equivalent role that manages licensing and capacity.
claims.quote: To manage Copilot Studio capacity, you need the Power Platform Administrator or Global Administrator role, or an equivalent role that can manage licensing and capacity.

claims.claim: Agent monthly limits apply to Copilot Studio agents generally, rather than only SharePoint list knowledge.
claims.quote: Admins can set monthly consumption limits for each Copilot Studio agent, regardless of whether the environment uses prepaid capacity or pay-as-you-go billing.

claims.claim: An enabled agent hard stop turns the agent off at its monthly limit.
claims.quote: Hard stop: The agent is automatically turned off once it hits the defined limit.

claims.claim: Agent limits are not applied instantly.
claims.quote: Limits aren't applied instantly. An agent can continue to respond for some time after it reaches its limit, so set limits and notification thresholds with some margin.

claims.claim: The Power Platform admin center path is Security > Data and privacy > Knowledge sources for agents > Environment groups > environment group > Manage knowledge sources > SharePoint + OneDrive.
claims.quote: select Security. ... Data and privacy ... Knowledge sources for agents ... Environment groups ... Select the environment group ... Manage knowledge sources. ... SharePoint + OneDrive

claims.claim: No API operation for the Knowledge sources for agents setting is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "knowledge sources for agents" "API" "rule". Opened Configure knowledge sources for agents, pac governance, and Rule Sets - Update Rule Set; generic rule operations exist but no knowledge-source rule identifier or setting mapping is documented.

claims.claim: Knowledge sources for agents is configurable at environment as well as environment-group level.
claims.quote: This setting is available at both the environment and environment group level.

claims.claim: The SharePoint + OneDrive setting offers None, All and Custom.
claims.quote: None: Don't use any SharePoint and OneDrive sites as knowledge sources. ... All: Use all SharePoint and OneDrive sites as knowledge sources. ... Custom: Select which SharePoint and OneDrive sites agents can use.

claims.claim: Custom permits Allow or Deny for SharePoint and OneDrive site URLs.
claims.quote: Custom: Select which SharePoint and OneDrive sites agents can use. Agents reference them in priority order, starting with the first URL. Select either Allow or Deny under Access for each URL.

claims.claim: The rule documentation does not explain treatment of individual list URLs in Custom.
claims.quote: Searched: "knowledge sources for agents" "Custom" "list". Opened Configure knowledge sources for agents and Choose knowledge sources for agents built in Copilot Studio; the Custom instructions name site URLs, not individual list URLs.

claims.claim: An environment cannot modify a knowledge-source setting imposed at environment-group level.
claims.quote: if an admin sets the control at the environment group level, then it's distributed to the environment level and can't be modified there.

claims.claim: The Knowledge sources for agents admin documentation is marked preview.
claims.quote: Configure knowledge sources for agents in the Power Platform admin center (preview) ... [This article is prerelease documentation and is subject to change.]

claims.claim: The SharePoint + OneDrive rule maps to Upload files > SharePoint, the upload entry used by Learn's list-addition steps.
claims.quote: Upload files > SharePoint | SharePoint + OneDrive | Configures whether agents can use SharePoint and OneDrive sites as knowledge sources.

claims.claim: The limit UI is reached through Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Summary > Manage Agents.
claims.quote: select Licensing. ... under Products, select Copilot Studio. ... On the Summary tab, select Manage Agents. ... You can set a monthly limit for any agent directly from this page.

claims.claim: No API operation for setting an individual agent's monthly credit limit is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio agent monthly consumption limit Stop usage API PowerShell. Opened Manage Copilot Credits and capacity, Manage costs for Microsoft Copilot harness, and Govern Copilot Credit consumption; no agent-limit setter reference found.

claims.claim: Power Platform administrators can configure environment-group rules.
claims.quote: Power Platform tenant administrators can immediately add managed environments or configure the group's rules.

claims.claim: Learn best practices advise evaluations before production rollout.
claims.quote: Run evaluations and validate your queries before production rollout.

claims.claim: Manage Agents exposes month-to-date billed credits.
claims.quote: See month-to-date billed credits.

claims.claim: The pac governance reference has environment-group rule-set commands but does not name this knowledge-source rule.
claims.quote: Searched: "knowledge sources for agents" "API" "rule"; read the full pac governance reference and Rule Sets - Update Rule Set. They document create/update rule sets and generic parameters, but do not name the Knowledge sources for agents rule.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The capability is user-opt-in: a maker must add a list, rather than existing agents acquiring list knowledge automatically.
claims.quote: Select Add to agent to finish adding the knowledge source. Searched: Copilot Studio SharePoint lists knowledge source enable admin default setting; no dedicated feature switch found, only existing knowledge-source policy and Dataverse search prerequisites.

claims.claim: After Manage Agents, the admin selects the agent and Set limit, then enables Stop usage for enforcement.
claims.quote: Select the agent, and then select Set limit. ... Turn on Stop usage if the agent should be turned off when it reaches the limit.

claims.claim: Manage Agents exposes agent status.
claims.quote: Monitor agent status, such as Nearing limit, Over limit, or Within limit.

claims.claim: The downloadable detailed consumption report includes a Knowledge sources / Tool used column.
claims.quote: The detailed report adds the Product / AI feature, Channel, LLM model, and Knowledge sources / Tool used columns.

claims.claim: SharePoint lists commonly hold operational and business records.
claims.quote: Many organizations store important operational and business data in SharePoint lists, such as help desk tickets, course catalogs, backlogs, and more.

claims.claim: The variable cost rating reflects metered Copilot Credit usage.
claims.quote: Usage is billed based on consumption and measured in Copilot Credits.
